Path.description: Path or URL to the folder containing the acquired data.

Sample.description: Select the one sample resource measured in this session.

voltage.description: Actual TEM accelerating voltage in kV when a single setting is known for the session. Use acquisition metadata for per-file values.

end_time.description: Enter the actual session end in the microscope facility's local time, when known.

Microscope.description: Select the one TEM microscope resource used for this session.

start_time.description: Enter the actual session start in the microscope facility's local time.

Other_notes.description: Record any other information relevant to the session.

Technical_issues.description: Report here any issues encountered during the session.

experiment_description.description: Describe the goal of the session, the question to answer, and any areas of interest agreed with the sample owner. Use the notebook body for free annotations during the session.
